repo_audit.finding: States individuals disposing of foreign currency in a personal transaction are exempt from IRC § 988 ordinary currency-gain rules without noting that personal exchange gains exceeding $200 ARE taxable as capital gains.

repo_audit.disposition: Directly verified in body of both 26 U.S.C. § 988(e)(2) and IRS Pub. 525 (2025) chunk 39.

flags.title: Account-holder private facts, origin of CNY, and prior tax filings are unknown
flags.blank_fields: Personal PRC tax owed, U.S. residual tax owed, individual route eligibility
flags.explanation: Whether the stuck CNY came from already-taxed salary, untaxed consulting/business receipts, apartment sale proceeds, inheritance, company retained earnings, or previously converted USD — plus your China residency days and U.S. tax/FBAR history — determines both legal eligibility and actual tax owed. Nothing is inferred.

flags.title: Executable bank CNY→USD FX spread is unconfirmed in official/static sources
flags.blank_fields: Bank FX Spread (USD), All-In Total Cost (USD), Net USD Received
flags.explanation: Chinese and international banks quote CNY→USD telegraphic-transfer selling rates (现汇卖出价) dynamically throughout the trading day and do not publish a fixed basis-point spread in static regulatory or tariff documents. All FX spread and all-in net USD columns are therefore left strictly blank.

flags.title: Correspondent / intermediary SWIFT lifting fees (under SHA) and U.S. receiving wire fees are unconfirmed
flags.explanation: HSBC China Tariff Important Note 7 explicitly states its charges exclude fees collected by other institutions, overseas HSBC Group members, or agent/correspondent banks. Even under Pay Exact (OUR, +CNY 200), any overseas bank shortfall remains collectible from the remitter.

flags.title: Wise From-CNY percentage and fixed fee schedule is quoted only in-app
flags.blank_fields: Wise Published Fee (USD) for M03 & M04
flags.explanation: Wise's official CNY help guide confirms eligibility (<=3-year tax records, non-mainland passport, own account) and batch caps (CNY 300,000 bank app / CNY 50,000 Alipay), but directs users to set up a live transfer in-app to view exact fees.

flags.title: Notarization, apostille, translation, and international courier fees for M05 proxy handling are unconfirmed
flags.blank_fields: Proxy / Apostille / Courier Cost (USD) for M05
flags.explanation: While SAFE rules authorize entrusting salary FX purchase/remittance to an agent, third-party notary, apostille, and courier charges vary by U.S. state and PRC branch requirements and are left blank.

flags.title: Statutory vs. operational definition of 'domestic individual' (境内个人) and USD 50,000 purchase quota
flags.blank_fields: M06 Quota Eligibility without PRC Permanent Resident ID
flags.explanation: State Council Decree 532 Art. 52(2) defines 境内个人 to include foreigners continuously residing in China >=1 year, whereas PBOC Decree [2006] No. 3 Art. 37 and SAFE Tianjin 2024 Case 9 restrict facilitated annual USD 50,000 FX PURCHASE (购汇) for foreigners to holders of a PRC Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card.

flags.title: Zero published counter banknote fee ($0.00) does NOT mean zero all-in cash cost
flags.blank_fields: Cash FX Spread & International Travel Cost for M08, M17, M18
flags.explanation: HSBC China publishes 'Free' for counter foreign-currency banknote withdrawal (2.2.2.1) and group cash exchange (2.2.2.2), but explicitly applies cash buy/sell board rates (wider than telegraphic rates) and does not include airfare, insurance, or offshore exchange spreads.

flags.title: PRC real-estate sale taxes depend on city, holding period, original cost basis, and residential status
flags.explanation: PRC IIT Law Art. 3(3) sets a 20% flat rate on net property-transfer gain, while local VAT/deed/land-appreciation exemptions depend on holding years and self-use status, and U.S. gain depends on historical USD basis and IRC § 121 eligibility.

flags.title: USD fee illustrations use IRS 2025 yearly average (7.129 CNY/USD) and HSBC China's published tariff only
flags.blank_fields: Other PRC Domestic Bank Tariffs (BOC / ICBC / CMB / CCB)
flags.explanation: If your account is at a state-owned PRC bank rather than HSBC China, its counter telegraphic-transfer commission and cable charge follow that bank's own published tariff. Moreover, 7.129 CNY/USD is a historical 2025 tax-translation average, not today's spot rate.

flags.title: HSBC China tariff PDF contains mixed effective-date headers and segment eligibility conditions
flags.blank_fields: Unqualified Premier Monthly Fee / Post-Mar-2026 Advance Availability
flags.explanation: Cover page states effective 31 Oct 2026 while certain internal Chinese headers say 2024年9月12日生效; Qualified Premier requires CNY 500,000 TRB (or overseas Home-Country Premier), and new Advance applications were restricted on 18 Mar 2026.

flags.title: Corporate EIT, statutory reserve, CPA audit fees, and U.S. CFC (Form 5471 / GILTI) impacts on M12 & M13
flags.blank_fields: Pre-Dividend Corporate Tax & Audit Fees; U.S. Residual Tax after FTC
flags.explanation: While the 10% U.S.–China Treaty Art. 9(2) dividend withholding rate and HSBC entity wire fee ($33.67–$159.91) are published, corporate pre-dividend taxes, CPA audit fees, and U.S. Subpart F/GILTI inclusions depend on entity facts.

flags.title: Commercial FX settlement-account tariffs for registered individual foreign-trade operators (M14) are unpublished here
flags.explanation: SAFE manages M14 settlement accounts under institutional rules; bank corporate/institutional trade settlement tariffs vary by bank and are left blank.

flags.title: Mainland card-issuer overseas ATM / POS fees and U.S. ATM operator surcharges are unconfirmed
flags.blank_fields: M15 ATM Fees & M16 Card POS Fees
flags.explanation: Per-withdrawal issuer commissions, UnionPay/Visa/Mastercard conversion spreads, and U.S. ATM surcharges across up to 286 withdrawals ($400k) vary by card issuer and ATM operator and are left blank.

flags.title: RMB 20,000 cross-border cash limit verified from official PBOC Q&A rather than original Gazette decree text
flags.blank_fields: Offshore CNH Cash Spread for M18
flags.explanation: PBOC's official English Q&A directly confirms the RMB 20,000 per person per trip limit (marked verified-limited because it is an official PBOC Q&A summary of Public Notice [2004] No. 18).

flags.title: Western Union China bank-account payout unavailable and static fee/limit schedule unpublished
flags.explanation: Western Union China's live page states transfers to recipient bank accounts are 'temporarily unavailable' and directs customers to partner banks (BOC, CEB, SPDB, PSBC) for pricing and local regulatory limits.

flags.title: Closed-loop investment channels (GBA Wealth Management Connect / QDII) cannot exit to U.S. accounts and create U.S. PFIC risk
flags.blank_fields: USD Delivered to U.S. Bank ($0 — Closed Loop)
flags.explanation: PBOC enforces closed-loop fund remittance pipes (资金闭环汇划管道) on GBA Wealth Management Connect, and non-U.S. mutual funds generally trigger punitive U.S. PFIC (Form 8621) rules.

flags.title: Statutory 30%–100% PRC fines on M21–M23 are legal penalty exposure, NOT a lawful transaction price
flags.explanation: State Council Decree 532 Arts. 39, 40, and 45 set administrative fines up to 30% (and 30%–100% in serious cases) plus criminal liability. Shown in cost tables strictly as statutory penalty exposure.

flags.title: U.S. Code (2024 GPO edition), eCFR (authoritative online update), State income taxes, and non-authoritative PRC English translations
flags.blank_fields: U.S. State Income Tax (0%–13.3%+ depending on state domicile)
flags.explanation: 26 U.S.C. § 988 was verified from the 2024 GPO U.S. Code edition; 31 CFR § 1010.821 from eCFR (current to 2026-11-06); many U.S. states do NOT allow a Foreign Tax Credit for PRC taxes; and PRC English translations specify that Chinese text prevails.
